notes.title: An update has arrived for Tyrgard
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello fellow archers.[/h2]

During the summer we have been working on some updates and bug fixes for Tyrgard

[h3]We have added a barn and a practice range[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100240/fd251352b9f926c29f7b11f399e06cf4ccc2cf78.png[/img]

[list]
[*] The barn is where you grab your bow and shoot the targets hiding. It is a time based game mode that starts when you pull down the lever. 
[*] a standard practice range. You can turn the wheel to decide how far the target should be out. if you pull the lever it activates the hiscores and you'll be given 10 arrows. The further out the target is the higher score it will award you when hitting the bullseye. Now go claim your spot on the leaderboard!
[/list]

The annoying 1+ enemies remaining should now have been fixed along with other minor bugs.

notes.title: Minor game update, Exit button!
notes.notes: Just a minor update, With Tyrgaard we have always been focusing more on the gameplay than the game menu and how to exit the game. Hence having no in-game way to exit without Alt+F4. this has now changed. We still don't want to split the focus from the gameplay but we have seen a few bugs where the game closes, but Steam still thinks it is open. So now you can exit the game using the escape button.

notes.title: Ambidextrous bow & visual update.
notes.notes:
Hello fellow viking archer badasses!

We have officially updated the game with a new bow, that can be used in any hand! Not only that but we have also changed the visuals for more color and clear vision!

Updated Bow

The bow can now be used in either hand. Just use the grab trigger to pick it up! Want to change hands, well just grab it with the other hand to switch it over. No need to hold the grab trigger down, just press it once to keep it in that hand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100240/d1aacef8c271a7bf1daf0dfc9f71e26233ee78af.gif[/img]


More weight and feedback.

We have added a more realistic gravity pull to the arrow, giving it more weight and feeling of being real. This also makes those charged precise shots feel more worth it for those long range hits.
The bow now also feels more real to interact with through haptic feedback.

Visual update

We have updated the levels visuals, as well as the arrow trail, and explosive effects of frost arrow and explosive arrow.



That's all for now, but we are still working on improving the game, and more will come!

If you have any feedback then let us know at info@actura-studios.com!

So long!
- The dev team
